characters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create PRISMO, an original mathematics mascot for a school quiz game where teachers create quizzes for any subject. Use the attached VOLTIO image ONLY as a style reference: same collectible glossy 3D vinyl toy finish, large expressive friendly eyes, navy limbs, oversized sneakers, rounded forms, playful confident energy, soft studio light and faint cyan rim light. PRISMO is an anthropomorphic rounded geometric cube: big electric-cyan cube head/body with a clearly visible navy side face and yellow beveled edges, small navy arms and legs, navy/cyan sneakers with coral details and white soles. A small friendly pair of round navy glasses frames its big eyes. Clever mischievous smile. One open hand presents three small simple solid geometric objects, a yellow sphere, a coral cone and a cyan cube, clustered closely above the palm. The objects are plain physical geometry models, with no writing or markings. Character design should immediately communicate mathematics through geometry, without written numerals or equations. Different silhouette and identity from VOLTIO; no lightning emblems. Exactly one character, full body, centered, facing forward with slight three-quarter turn, relaxed standing base pose. Clean generous transparent margin at least 10% on every side, square 1024x1024 PNG with genuine alpha transparency. No ground, no floor shadow, no backdrop, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no existing characters, no fear or violence.
